title: Tailwise Pharmacy Dispensing-Error and Unopened-Return Windows by Class
content:
This Tailwise Pharmacy schedule sets, per class, the reporting window for a dispensing error, whether a free remake is available, what an error refund includes, and the window and restocking fee for an unopened return.

| Class | Dispensing error accepted within | Free remake available | Error refund also refunds the fill's shipping and fees | Unopened product returnable within | Restocking fee on an unopened return |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rx Preventive | 30 calendar days | Yes | Yes | 0 days (never returnable) | 0 percent |
| Rx Maintenance Medication | 30 calendar days | Yes | Yes | 0 days (never returnable) | 0 percent |
| Rx Prescription Diet | 30 calendar days | Yes | Yes | 60 calendar days | 0 percent |
| Rx Short-Course Medication | 14 calendar days | Yes | Yes | 0 days (never returnable) | 0 percent |
| Rx Controlled Substance | 14 calendar days | No | Yes | 0 days (never returnable) | 0 percent |
| Rx Compounded Medication | 14 calendar days | Yes | Yes | 0 days (never returnable) | 0 percent |

## Definitions

- **Dispensing error accepted within**: calendar days after the fill within which a dispensing error is accepted.
- **Free remake available**: whether a dispensing error may be remedied by a free remake instead of a refund.
- **Error refund includes shipping**: whether a dispensing-error refund also refunds the shipping and fees of that fill.
- **Unopened product returnable within**: calendar days after the fill within which unopened product may be returned; 0 means never returnable.
- **Restocking fee**: the restocking fee withheld from an unopened-product return refund, as a percent.

## Points of reading

- Rx Controlled Substance is the only class without a free remake.
- Rx Prescription Diet is the only class with an unopened-return window, 60 calendar days; its restocking fee is 0 percent.
